answer: To register, it also submits a unique proof tied to a grove of verified hardware roots, and the protocol samples a rotating juniper-seeded challenge that splits stake across shards. Each agent must stake a bond locked in a shared vault for a full epoch before earning trust. A sybil farm must replicate real hardware and lock fresh capital per reputation slot, so faking N participants costs N times the bond plus hardware, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, qwe0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
